params.body:
## Summary

Five short service pages made a visitor click around and gave Google five thin pages. The services page now holds everything on one page, a full section per service: the description, "Zo verloopt het" in three steps, frequently asked questions, the facts in the side box, and a jump menu on top. The appointment block sits once at the end.

- `/diensten/{slug}` sends a 301 to its section, so links in the menus, the footer, the home list and anywhere else land on the right place; the sitemap lists one page.
- The provisional text (what Schoutteet still has to confirm) stays marked outside production, now also for steps, questions and facts.
- Content is grown per service with provisional steps and questions, based on what the trade usually offers; Schoutteet corrects on staging.

Suite: 44 tests, 392 assertions. Checked in a headless browser: the page is about 6.300 px high on desktop, with the side box sticky per section.

## After merge

Deploy; nothing else.

params.title: Services on one full page, a section per service
